Avery: Big personal news—baby on the way (due Oct) and I accepted a promotion to Lead Designer today!! :tada: Want to do a tiny celebration + diaper shower next Friday?
Liam: Wow congrats!!! :confetti_ball::heart_eyes: Count me in.

Avery: Thinking 4pm in the lounge. Low-key: cake, coffee, and a onesie decorating corner?
Noor: 4pm works. I can bring icing pens for the onesies. Also can make a small gift list in the thread?
Diego: Ill grab savory platters. Vote: :cake: cake, :cupcake: cupcakes, :baby: baby-shaped cookies?
Liam: :cake:
Sofia: :baby:
Noor: :cupcake:
party-bot: Reminder set for "Avery celebration" at 3071238400 (Fri 16:00)  4 RSVPs so far.
